project.name: Whitfield granny flat, 18 Tuckeroo Crescent
project.summary: The base Whitfield granny flat, but a Sydney Water sewer main runs along the rear boundary and the flat sits within its zone of influence, so the rear edge is carried on piers and Sydney Water approves building next to the asset before the CDC is determined. Everything else is unchanged.

documents.content: Building designer's fee proposal; the firm describes itself as accredited building designers, not architects. Scope and fee by stage: Stage 1 concept design (site analysis on the survey, placing the flat clear of the house drain and inside the setbacks, one round of changes) $2,800; Stage 2 CDC documentation and lodgement (CDC drawings, site plan with setbacks and services routes from the main house, BASIX commitments on the drawings, certifier liaison, and the water authority asset submission: Sydney Water Tap in building plan approval with the asset assessment for building next to the main along the rear boundary) $4,200; Stage 3 construction drawings, finishes and fixtures schedule and specification for builders' quotes $2,000; total $9,000 ex GST. Option: quote-period support (answering builders' questions, comparing quotes) $600 ex GST. Additional services at $140 per hour ex GST. Exclusions: other consultants, certifier, council and Sydney Water fees. The 'Stage 1 ... Stage 3' fee stages are not construction stages.
